note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown and only the soldier is described; the Other section records the discussion of generic placement; nomenclatural and type-material records, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brownish yellow; nasus light brown; antennae, pronotum and legs pale yellow. Head densely covered with short, curved hairs and a few longer setae; nasus hairy only near the base; pronotum with a few hairs. Head capsule pyriform (1.28 mm long including nasus, 0.69 mm maximum width); in lateral view depressed at the base of the nasus, convex behind it. Nasus weakly conical, thick at the base (0.49 mm long), more depressed than the head. Antennae 11-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2. Mandibles small, vestigial; without points or apical processes. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin slightly incurved; posterior margin rounded (0.15 mm long, 0.38 mm maximum width).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original description and figures place this species in the Subulitermes group; Eleanoritermes is characterized by 11-segmented soldier antennae, a densely hairy head and slightly convex sides of the head, and the soldier of this species shows this combination as well, but the type specimen could not be examined and the species is provisionally retained in its original genus. In the remaining Nasutitermes the soldier antennae are 12–14-segmented and the head pilosity is sparse.
